_comment: PointsBet competition name -> tourney_name in matches_with_holdout.parquet. PointsBet names Masters events by city ('ATP Montreal'); the match history names them by the event ('Canada Masters'), so the fuzzy resolver in Reference.tournament matches neither and the fixture is skipped. Data, not code: an entry here shows up in a diff. Only map a name when the event is unambiguously the same tournament. Reviewed and committed, same rules as player_aliases.json. Same problem for one Grand Slam: PointsBet brands Roland Garros 'French Open' (see 'French Open Futures'), which the fuzzy resolver cannot bridge to the history's 'Roland Garros'. The exact live men's-draw name is unconfirmed (inferred from the 'US Open Men's' pattern seen 2026-09-02) — if it turns out to differ, this entry is a harmless no-op and the fixture goes on skipping until corrected.
